title: f108r complete amulet commentary with 71 frozen meanings: persistent depiction, conditional assembly claim and selected part after enclosure
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. The sole whole crossleaf ZL paragraph meeting the declared >=30 groups, >=10 inherited types and <=20 unknown types rule has 33 groups, 10 old types at 15 positions, and 17 new types at 18 positions. A complete four-clause exploratory descendant freezes all 71 RAW486 meanings and both physical-part branches. It adds explicit topic-to-assembly and selected-part reference rules; these are counted assumptions, not confirmed crossleaf continuity. No semantic test was run.

decision_note.genuinely_unknown: Can this exact 33-group crossleaf paragraph be jointly interpreted with the complete original amulet instructions while all 71 old denotations, physical identities, source-part alternatives and assembly interval remain fixed? Lexical coverage does not answer this. The proposed answer here is a fully stated hypothesis, not an execution result.
decision_note.smallest_adequate_later_check: If selected, bind all four new clauses and every old clause, construct the two unchanged E/H instruction traces, and separately inspect their identity, host/under relations and attributed-claim payloads. Compare the fixed direct-subject and depicted-kind alternatives below. No new cipher, interpreter or broad corpus is needed for this proposal.
decision_note.outcomes: A scope/type contradiction would reject this exact descendant without changing RAW486. Coherence would retain a two-leaf exploratory family with 88 guessed whole values; it would not establish any word meaning or distinguish an independently coherent rival. A rival that is equally coherent must be reported as unresolved, not scored as a failure.
decision_note.budget_breakdown: 10 primary/target binding, 15 reuse or manually inspect complete branch traces, 10 independent validation, 10 compact publication. No expansion if the result is only definitional bookkeeping.

selection_receipt.predeclared_before_winner_text_read: For each fixed family RAW486 (71 amulet values, own leaf 83) and RAW484 (23 graft values, own leaf 17), consider existing complete ZL3b paragraphs on another admitted physical leaf. Require >=30 groups, >=10 different exact inherited word forms, and <=20 exact unknown forms. Sort decreasing inherited-position/total-position rational fraction, then inherited-type/total-type fraction, then paragraph ID. No semantic fit or cleaned spelling entered the rank.
selection_receipt.arithmetic_only: This inventory is exact string membership and counts, not a semantic experiment or a selection-safety claim.

graft.limit: No candidate under this voluntarily strict selection rule; not proof that graft meanings cannot extend or that every complete family was screened.

selection_receipt.access: Same already admitted 179-selector GDT928 source packet; existing boundary-complete JSON records only. Physical source leaf excluded, f84/f84r sealed, f116v absent/not admitted; no new page or image was opened.

transcription_limits: ZL f108r.46 and .47 both retain anchor_eligible=false; the proposal does not infer or repair the reason for these flags.
IT2a has 32 groups rather than 33. At .46, ZL qokeed y corresponds to one IT qokeedy, which is already the frozen WING_TIP_OF operator. It cannot inherit the new ENCLOSED_STATE plus AND reading.
The .47 word strings agree in these records while the eligibility flags differ; agreement does not erase ZL uncertainty.
The parent f83r projected/raw differences and alternative reader changes remain exactly as recorded in RAW486. No claim of a literal exact 117-group manuscript reading is made.

grammar_contract_unchanged.terminals: Every exact projected word and space is retained. One fixed lexical entry per whole form throughout all nine lines. No EVA component meaning, phonetic rule, silent filler or arbitrary skipped token.
grammar_contract_unchanged.productions: Exactly the nine terminal-tag sequences printed in complete_clauses, in the nine inherited line positions, with the stated reductions. These are nine freely fitted clause schemas, not a learned general language or an independent statistical constraint.
grammar_contract_unchanged.compile_before_execute: First resolve declarations, types, goal expressions, the C06/C07 alternative and anaphoric references from the complete program. Then execute its imperative plan. Declarative REQUIRE_POSITION and RETAIN are not performed placements or second engravings. A mentioned future physical component does not appear inside the assembly before placement.
grammar_contract_unchanged.goal_scope: GOAL in C01 governs ENCLOSE and its AS_AMULET/FOR_WEAR/FOR_PROTECTION complements only. It records the same operation as later ENCLOSE but does not execute it. No other word or occurrence receives a goal exemption.
grammar_contract_unchanged.choice_scope: ALTERNATIVELY in C07 joins exactly C06 and C07 as the two values of material bird-kind(P). Exactly one branch executes. It does not replace the depicted eagle, change the seed/wearer/stone or cause both bird parts to be installed.
grammar_contract_unchanged.actor_elision: There is one instruction addressee W, identical to both explicit WEARER occurrences and YOU. C07 and the imperatives in C01/C08 inherit this actor. No second hidden person is introduced.
reference_resolution: THE_ENGRAVING is the unique I produced by ENGRAVE_ON(S,IMAGE_OF(E)).
ITS_CARRIER, THERE and THE_STONE resolve S; SAME enforces identity, not merely stone kind.
SELECTED BIRD_PART creates component role P; C06/C07 resolve its provenance to E or H.
THAT_PART in C07 resolves this MaterialPart role, never the Depiction role I.
THAT_ASSEMBLY resolves A, which contains the same S and the selected physical components.
ALL_PREVIOUS AILMENTS remains a source chapter backreference, not a free disease-choice parameter.
recurring_new_forms: aiin=OF at both .10 positions; typed arguments distinguish representation provenance from material provenance.
dal=WITH at both .14 positions; groups distinct materials or accompanies the carrier, without fusing them.
shcthy=PLACES at .14 and .15; same pose-consuming operation in the two material alternatives.
grammar_contract_unchanged.inverse: Keep a source locator for every terminal and reduction. An exact projected-text inverse checks coverage only; it cannot prove the proposed meanings or settle three raw forms.
grammar_contract_unchanged.uniform_WITH: Both dal tokens denote the same binary accompaniment relation WITH(left,right). C06 has WITH(P,G) as the material group and WITH(group,S) as its carrier frame. The fixed clause production assigns those typed argument positions; neither WITH occurrence executes placement or fuses objects.

entities.P: one physical wing/feather-tip component, source kind chosen E or H
entities.I: one depiction record hosted on S and representing E
entities.A: one planned composite amulet with S,G,P; distinct from S

semantic_contract_unchanged.initial_state: S is available, unengraved and not enclosed. G and one part appropriate to the selected source branch are available as loose material. W is the addressee. A is a plan identifier with no executed assembly, enclosure or wearing yet. Source material availability and one actor are declared assumptions, not observations of f83r.

typed_OF.Form+BirdKind: representation-content relation only; no bird body or material is created
typed_OF.MaterialPart+BirdBody: physical provenance from a body of the selected bird kind; does not change what I depicts
typed_OF.limit: A depiction may have a physical carrier; the type distinction does not assert that all images are metaphysically immaterial. It prevents the represented bird from counting as the detachable ingredient.

operations.TAKE: Require a loose available physical object; put it into W's working possession. Do not change its identity or kind.
operations.IMAGE_OF: Construct a Depiction value of the argument BirdKind. It is not a MaterialPart.
operations.ENGRAVE_ON: Require S taken and not enclosed; host I on S with depicted_kind(I)=E. S persists.
operations.REQUIRE_UNDER: Store one intended placement relation UNDER(item,S); no world placement occurs.
operations.PREPARE_ITEMS: Check that the branch-selected P and the same G are available loose to W. This is an executable availability precondition, not a separate ownership/identity mutation. A missing material fails it; a repeated name never creates another item.
operations.PLACES: Require each item to be MaterialObject, loose, available, and to have exactly one resolved pose relative to S. Apply its UNDER relation and record it as an assembled component with S. In C07 UNDER_CARRIER spells the same pose explicitly. S,G,P remain distinct.
operations.ENCLOSE: Require S with its eagle depiction and both G/P already placed below it. Close assembly A around exactly those components; cannot consume I as the bird-part material. Does not replace S, G, P or I.
operations.GOAL: Quote a typed operation plus purpose predicates into the instruction specification. It has no physical-world effect; the same ENCLOSE denotation is later applied under THEN.
operations.WEAR: Require A enclosed; set worn_by(A)=W. The wearer does not become a component.
operations.CLAIM: Append an attributed proposition to a claim record. Never infer actual protection, medical cure or social favor from this bookkeeping.
operations.CLOSE_SECTION: Close the named text section, not the physical assembly.
operations.PREPARE: Check availability of the named loose material to W; pending spatial requirements are separately supplied by REQUIRE_UNDER. This check creates no extra physical object or preparation-state flag.

mandatory_relations: host(I)=S and depicted_kind(I)=E survive both branches.
UNDER(G,S) and UNDER(P,S) hold before executed enclosure.
components(A)={S,G,P}; image I is hosted by S rather than a substituted loose bird part.
C06/C07 chooses exactly one bird-part provenance; G/S/W identities do not vary with that choice.
Goal ENCLOSE does not set enclosed(A); executed ENCLOSE does.
All source effect and closure clauses are consumed without treating unlisted effects as invented explicit properties.
semantic_contract_unchanged.anatomical_uncertainty: The part category stays WING_OR_FEATHER_TIP in the semantic record. The difference is not needed to decide depiction-versus-part or E/H substitution, and this model does not choose one precise anatomy.
semantic_contract_unchanged.instruction_not_history: Simulation asks what would result if the whole proposed recipe were followed. The target hypothesis need not assert that any person actually made or wore such an object.
state_fields: identity/kind of physical S,G,P and actor W
semantic_contract_unchanged.assembly_identity: At compilation A receives planned_components={S,G,P}. This is a requirement, not an assertion of physical assembly. PLACES supplies actual poses and assembled_components; only then can ENCLOSE set enclosed(A). The selected P has one physical identity within each branch; E/H branches are alternative executions, not the same object changing species.
semantic_contract_unchanged.order: The imperative plan is TAKE(S), ENGRAVE_ON(S,IMAGE_OF(E)), common availability/pose requirements, exactly one material-placement branch, ENCLOSE(A), WEAR(W,A), attributed claims and section closure. Declarations in C02/C04/C05 constrain this whole plan without creating extra physical events. C06 and C07 differ in an explicit availability check as written, but both require availability in PLACES and have the same final physical structure apart from P provenance.

okeey.meaning: The argument retains its individual identity across the named assembly process. Same predicate for the engraving I and grape seed G; neither continued loose availability nor unchanged position is asserted.

keey.meaning: Conjoin the two adjacent assertions. A new whole-word synonym of y, openly counted.

dalkedy.meaning: Introduce the condition inside an attributed protection proposition. IF C THEN PROTECTS(A,W,Q), not the converse and not actual efficacy.

yteedy.meaning: The already specified two-member material group {G,P}; P is the physical part of the current E or H branch. This fixed group-reference macro is one new value and introduces no object.

qokeed.meaning: The existing assembly A is physically enclosed. This is a state predicate, not a second ENCLOSE action and not a goal quotation.

y.meaning: Conjoin two adjacent state predicates. Same logical conjunction as keey; the synonym is not inferred from spelling.

qokey.meaning: The existing assembly A is worn, with the wearer supplied by BY. This is a state predicate, not a new wearing action.

otedy.meaning: Bind the immediately following Person as the wearer argument of WORN_STATE.

cheodar.meaning: The implicit engraving argument retains its identity; this does not assert unchanged material composition, shape or position of every object.

cheey.meaning: The depiction argument is hosted on the physical carrier argument, with the same host relation as the parent engraving operation.

yched.meaning: Universally quantify the preceding invariant over states in the explicitly named ASSEMBLY interval of the finite instruction trace.

chockhey.meaning: Declare the preceding proposition as an invariant constraint on the instruction trace; no extra physical event.

sheol.meaning: The physical part is below the explicitly named carrier. The argument order is specified by production C13, not guessed separately at each occurrence.

lkeedy.meaning: The carrier S already introduced by the parent engraving instruction; an explicit new reference alias, not a new stone.

oteedy.meaning: Require that the following physical part retain the stated pose over the explicitly supplied time region. Does not create or place a part.

ched.meaning: The source bird kind of the already selected physical component P: E in the eagle branch, H in the hawk branch. This is a new branch-dependent reference constructor, not a constant eagle or a new choice.

keam.meaning: The suffix of the same finite instruction trace strictly after completion of the named assembly process, through that trace end; not all indefinitely possible future history.

complete_new_block_clauses.working_reading: But the engraving persists, and the grape seed persists.
complete_new_block_clauses.reduction: DiscourseContrast(previous=parent C09 final attributed OTHER_EFFECTS_UNSPECIFIED assertion, following=AND(PERSISTS(I,assembly_interval),PERSISTS(G,assembly_interval))). The final source-section closure is not treated as another physical assertion. This is a new commentary relationship, not a claim that unspecified effects destroy objects.

complete_new_block_clauses.working_reading: As regards the stone, the source protection claim is expressed conditionally: if that stone with the selected materials is enclosed and worn by the same wearer.
complete_new_block_clauses.reduction: Topic S1=the inherited S. Construct ordered accompaniment WITH(S2,SELECTED_MATERIALS={G,P}) with S2=S1. Resolve A as the unique already planned assembly whose components are exactly {S2,G,P}; do not identify A with S2. Resolve W2=SAME(WEARER)=the inherited W. Append CLAIM(IF(ENCLOSED(A) AND WORN_BY(A,W2),PROTECTS(A,W2,Q))), Q=the unchanged previous-ailment chapter reference. The two explicit STONE tokens remain S; the first is a topic and the second a physical member. The implicit claim bearer A and ailment argument Q are a new construction, not contained in the STONE denotation. No physical enclosure, wearing or health mutation occurs in this clause.

complete_new_block_clauses.working_reading: Require that the unchanged engraving remain hosted on the stone throughout assembly.
complete_new_block_clauses.reduction: Resolve the implicit depiction argument to I from THE_ENGRAVING in C10; require THROUGHOUT(assembly_interval,UNCHANGED_IDENTITY(I) AND HOSTED_BY(I,S)). ASSEMBLY is exactly the original gathering-and-enclosing process, with no new shorter interval. Postposed REQUIRE declares the invariant before the joint plan is executed.

complete_new_block_clauses.working_reading: But keep the wing-tip from the selected bird kind under that same carrier after assembly.
complete_new_block_clauses.reduction: DiscourseContrast(previous=C12 depiction-host invariant, following=KEEP(P,UNDER(P,S),AFTER(assembly_interval))). SAME(CARRIER_REFERENCE)=S.
